title: Remove color picker, username-only LinkedIn/GitHub inputs, fix vCard URL coverage
body:
Simplifies the theme color UI, tightens LinkedIn/GitHub input UX by accepting only usernames, and ensures both personal and work URLs are included in generated vCards.

## Changes

- **Color picker removed** — `<input type="color">` replaced by hex text input only; `colorPicker` DOM ref and its event listener removed
- **LinkedIn/GitHub — username-only inputs** — fields changed from `type="url"` (full URL) to `type="text"` with a visible base-URL prefix label (`https://linkedin.com/in/`, `https://github.com/`); stored value is the username only
- **Full URLs in QR & vCard** — FIELDS prefix for `linkedin`/`github` set to the respective base URLs so QR codes encode full URLs; `buildVCard` now prepends the base URLs for `X-SOCIALPROFILE` entries
- **Both website URLs in vCard confirmed** — `URL:` (personal) and `URL;TYPE=WORK:` (company) both emitted; no change needed
- **Backward compatibility** — on `load()`, existing stored values that are full LinkedIn/GitHub URLs are stripped to username-only before populating the input
